# xatlas

Vendored from [jpcy/xatlas](https://github.com/jpcy/xatlas) at commit
`f700c7790aaa030e794b52ba7791a05c085faf0c`.

Only the library source and license are retained. Adriatic uses xatlas to
generate cached, non-overlapping UV atlases for its procedural vehicle meshes.
The upstream code is licensed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.
